text:
Lena: Quick follow-up from the sec/privacy segment 1: collecting the minor clarifications we promised customers. Starting thread to capture short answers & owners.

Raj: Thanks! First 1: is ISO27001 formally on the roadmap and whats the target quarter?

Lena: Yes 1: ISO27001 target is Q4 2026. We'll publish milestones next week.

Dmitri: For Private (VPC/on-prem) customers: are audit logs exported to their SIEM by default or is that an integration we configure?

Priya: For Private deployments we can ship logs to customer-managed destinations (S3/GS or partner SIEM). It's a configurable integration; not automatic.

Raj: Good to know. Related : for Hosted customers asking about BYOK: any short answer copy I can drop in support tickets?

Priya: Short copy: "Hosted currently uses Redwood-managed KMS keys. BYOK is available for Private; Dedicated BYOK is planned for H2 2026. Contact sales for dedicated key needs."

Lena: Can someone confirm who owns proofs for network isolation (VPC peering, security groups) when we get an evidence request?

Dmitri: Infra owns the network diagrams + VPC configs. Compliance will sign the final pack. Engineering will extract app-level logs.

ComplianceBot: notice: new guidance published -> /internal/compliance/faq/basics-for-customer-asks (v2026-03-21)

Raj: What's our default log retention for evidence purposes? I need to tell customers a number.

Priya: Default retention: control plane & cloud audit = 365 days; application structured logs = 90 days; optional extended retention is a paid add-on.

Lena: For auditors we sometimes need examples of IAM change events. Dmitri, can you paste the usual query?

Dmitri: Sure, here's the snippet we hand to auditors (redacted):

```
# AWS CloudTrail: IAM policy changes
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=PutRolePolicy --start-time 2026-01-01 --end-time 2026-03-20

# GCP: admin activity
SELECT protoPayload.methodName, TIMESTAMP FROM `project.dataset.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity` WHERE protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%SetIamPolicy%' AND TIMESTAMP BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-20'
```

Raj: Perfect. One more: customers asked if audit logs are tamper-evident / immutable. Short answer?

Priya: We store audit logs in append-only storage with integrity checks (hashing) as part of evidence collection. We can provide attestations in the evidence pack.

Lena: Action items: 1) Priya to prepare canned BYOK/retention FAQ blurb for support (due 2026-03-28). 2) Dmitri to drop network config checklist in the evidence playbook (due 2026-03-30). 3) Raj to update the customer-facing FAQ page with retention & BYOK status (due 2026-03-29).

Dmitri: Will do. I'll also add a short example of how to pull TLS cert rotation events from our logs.

Priya: I'll draft the FAQ blurb and post a PR to the docs repo.

Lena: Thanks all. If any other follow-ups from folks who attended the all-hands, paste them here and we'll route to owners. :v
